MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World.
   D. Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Best practice when working on Western Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Western Ensembles.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Western Ensembles.

   D. Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple

6. Best practice when working on Contemporary Songs from Kenya: (1 mark)

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Contemporary Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Contemporary Songs.

9. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Western Ensembles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Western Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. C — Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Red, blue, and yellow

6. D — Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. B — Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Four-Part Harmony with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Ensembles; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
